title: Delivery Failure Days on Return-By Extensions
content:
When delivery of the order went wrong, a courtesy extension of a Returns & Exchanges return-by date adds delivery-failure days. They follow the Delivery Claims case on the return's order: its claim type and its status.

| Delivery Claims case on the return's order | Delivery-failure days added |
|---|---|
| Damaged in Transit Claim, Missing Item Claim or Wrong Item Claim, in status approved or resolved | 7 days |
| Late Delivery Claim, in status approved or resolved | 5 days |
| Any other order (no claim, a claim of another type, or a claim in another status) | None |

## Points of judgement

| Claim on the order | Status | Days added |
|---|---|---|
| Wrong Item Claim | Resolved | 7 |
| Damaged in Transit Claim | Approved | 7 |
| Late Delivery Claim | Approved | 5 |
| Missing Item Claim | Still under review (not approved or resolved) | None |
| Lost in Transit Claim | Resolved | None |

The claim read is the one opened on the same order as the return.
